statement: The record marks S-14 as “clear,” but that does not override the known hazardous condition that the target is within 6° of the Sun while it is up, so I will hold the pointing.
judge_text:
WRONG

The answer asserts the "clear" status is invalid because the target is within 6° of the Sun—a known hazard—and holds the pointing.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
